The root cause is the **sub-poller v1.8.0 deployment**, which changed subscription sync from every **60 seconds to every 5 seconds** and made each worker perform a full scan. Immediately afterward, docstore traffic rose from about **300 req/s to about 4,000 req/s**, CPU reached **100%**, and subscription collection scans became slow. Session requests then timed out waiting for docstore; retries amplified the load, and edge-gw returned 504s.

**Do now:** pause the sub-poller (**0 active workers**) to stop new full scans. Roll back v1.8.0, restore the **60-second** interval, and revert the per-worker full-scan behavior before re-enabling it. Do not change the healthy downstream services based on these metrics.
